g.text: ONE DB connection: (1) app -> 127.0.0.1:<branch port> (2) sidecar -> gateway: mTLS, hello = branch name, identity = cert uid (3) one HTTP/2 stream on the envoy's connection (4) authz, then port-forward -> branch pod

g.text: failure: a copy Failed ANYWHERE kills the preview everywhere - unreachable clusters escalate after 150s (only with queues) - preview stop bounded by a 90s window
